title: Jonik Cannon
description: A three-frame portrait of the photographer in a dark suit and tie, shot against the pale angled walls of a gallery interior.

title: Earth from space

title: Miami Beach sunrise panorama
description: A wide panorama of an empty beach at sunrise, raked sand sweeping across the foreground and hotel towers standing at either end of the bay.
